summary: Master NGO financial sustainability. Learn cost recovery, IFR4NPO standards, and revenue diversification to ensure long-term mission impact. Enroll today.
lede: NGO financial sustainability training helps nonprofit finance and program leaders plan for viable operations and continued mission delivery. This intermediate course is for finance managers, program directors, grant compliance staff and organizational leaders who need to strengthen long-term financial viability. Learners assess liquidity and reserves, develop diversified revenue plans, calculate full cost recovery, and build financial risk controls.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is essential for professionals responsible for the long-term viability and financial integrity of non-governmental organizations.
modules: Full Cost Recovery and Indirect Costs
Social Enterprise and Earned Income Models
Financial Risk Governance and Internal Controls
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in NGO finance, program management, or grant administration. A basic understanding of non-profit accounting principles and experience with budget management is required. Familiarity with standard spreadsheet software (Excel) is essential for the practical exercises.
